method: crop sheets of random boxes per source, plus whole frames; dHash/thumbnail pair sheets

findings.uavcb: boxes mostly correct, some loose; in camouflage cases the drone is nearly invisible in RGB (labels probably from thermal) -> hard/noisy positives; LabelMe polygons converted to min/max boxes
findings.antiuav300: boxes visually correct; tracker keeps the target centred; OSD overlay in every frame; night sessions show only lights
findings.uavdb: boxes centred on the hexacopter; static ground cameras, mostly sky with horizon
findings.vdd: Roboflow augmentation copies spread over official splits (2145 files / 717 originals); at least one shifted box found
findings.cranfield: synthetic; masks fragmented into several components per drone
findings.similar_pair_sheet: 13 random similarity pairs inspected: Halmstad<->pathikg and Halmstad<->Halmstad pairs are different plain-sky frames (no copies); Anti-UAV pairs are same site/OSD on different days; UAVDB pairs are the same static camera on different flights (same background, different drone position). No true cross-dataset copy found; exact byte duplicates across splits = 0.

limitations: no human review; frame-level label errors not quantified
